name: Fold Counter: Opening Tracker
subtitle: Daily Stats & Widgets
promotional_text: See your recorded openings, daily trends and widget totals. Automatic counting works only while the app is active on supported hardware.
description:
Keep a personal record of your foldable phone openings, with daily totals, clear history charts and widgets.

IMPORTANT: Automatic counting requires supported iPhone Duo hardware and this app to be active while a complete close-to-open movement is observed. Openings while the phone is locked, another app is active, or this app is suspended or closed are not recovered. This is not a 24/7 counter or a device-lifetime measurement.

YOUR OPENINGS, AT A GLANCE
See today's recorded openings, your all-time recorded total and a daily average. Sensor-observed openings and manual entries are clearly distinguished.

SEE YOUR HISTORY
Explore 7-, 30- and 90-day charts with daily breakdowns. The daily average includes zero-count days and today, beginning when your record was created.

WIDGETS FOR YOUR SAVED TOTALS
Add Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets to see saved counts. Widgets are snapshots: they do not monitor the hinge, and refresh timing is controlled by iOS.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR DATA
Use the counter without an account or internet connection. There are no ads, tracking or third-party analytics SDKs. Export daily history as CSV, back up your record as JSON, restore a backup or erase your saved counts. Device backups and files you choose to export remain under your control.

MANUAL ENTRY AND AN UNSAVED DEMO
Add an opening manually when needed. Try simulated folding in a separate demo that never changes your saved totals. Devices without a supported hinge provide manual entry and the demo only.

Designed with dark mode, adjustable text sizes and an adaptive interface.

Counts describe activity recorded by this app, not hardware health, remaining hinge life, warranty status or folds before installation. No hinge durability rating is assumed.
